text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with BTC leading the decline at -1.3%, suggesting mild pressure across the two majors without panic selling. The Fear & Greed index sits at 29—deep fear territory—and has held flat over a week, indicating sustained caution rather than capitulation or relief. Bitcoin's 56.2% dominance and a $47B 24-hour volume reflect a cautious but functioning market where traders are neither aggressively dumping nor rotating heavily into alternatives.
